source: HearthPwn user-submitted decks via github.com/NJacobsohn/Hearthstone-Data-Analysis, normalised to NDJSON then aggregated
measures: inclusion_rate = share of that era's ranked decks that ran the card at least once. This is deck-posting behaviour, NOT ladder playrate and NOT winrate -- the source has no games-played, no rank and no winrate field.
limits: Measures what players published on HearthPwn, not what was queued on ladder.
Archetype labels are author-entered and only ~43% of ranked rows carry one.
Coverage ends 2017-03-19; nothing from Un'Goro onward.
Deleted HearthPwn pages are simply absent (survivorship bias).
